mapper.select: SELECT id FROM media_assets WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND uploaded_by_user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_assets (uploaded_by_user_id, storage_key, mime_type, byte_size, width, height, sha256, status) VALUES (#{uploadedByUserId}, #{storageKey}, #{mimeType}, #{byteSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{sha256}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, uploaded_by_user_id AS uploadedByUserId, storage_key AS storageKey, mime_type AS mimeType, byte_size AS byteSize, width, height, status FROM media_assets WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND status = 'READY'

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_images pi JOIN products p ON p.id = pi.product_id JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id WHERE pi.media_id = #{mediaId} AND p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND s.enabled = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM shops WHERE logo_media_id = #{mediaId} AND enabled = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM brands WHERE logo_media_id = #{mediaId} AND enabled = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM product_review_images image JOIN product_reviews review ON review.id = image.review_id JOIN order_items item ON item.id = review.order_item_id JOIN products product ON product.id = review.product_id JOIN shops shop ON shop.id = product.shop_id WHERE image.media_id = #{mediaId} AND review.deleted_at IS NULL AND review.hidden_at IS NULL AND product.status = 'ON_SALE' AND shop.enabled = 1 AND item.quantity > ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refunded.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items refunded JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id = refunded.case_id WHERE refunded.order_item_id = item.id AND sale.status = 'REFUNDED' ) )
